member.name: M:FSH.Modules.Multitenancy.Features.v1.UpdateTenantTheme.UpdateTenantThemeCommandValidator.HexColorRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{8})$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match '#'.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a hexadecimal digit exactly 6 times.
○ Match a hexadecimal digit exactly 8 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
